minimum_supported_app_version.description: Lowest supported iOS app version. Versions below this value must update before continuing. Keep at 0.0.0 unless a shipped incident requires a block.

recommended_app_version.description: Recommended iOS app version. Versions below this value are prompted to update but may continue. Keep at 0.0.0 unless an update should be promoted.

workout_cloud_backup_writes_enabled.description: Kill switch. Off stops uploading workout documents and heart-rate sidecars; workouts stay queued locally and flush when it returns.

workout_remote_deletes_enabled.description: Kill switch. Off stops deleting remote workout documents and sidecars; tombstones stay queued locally and replay when it returns.

workout_sync_recovery_reopen_enabled.description: Kill switch. Off stops re-opening a stopped workout's automatic sync attempts after a build change, an epoch bump, or a repaired sign-in; the stopped state and unlimited manual retry are untouched.

workout_sync_recovery_epoch.description: Operator recovery epoch, NOT a kill switch. Bump it after a rules or backend fix to give every stopped workout one more automatic sync attempt without shipping a binary. Never decrease it.

workout_cloud_restore_enabled.description: Kill switch. Off stops decoding cloud backups into local storage on sign-in and reinstall.

workout_media_uploads_enabled.description: Kill switch. Off stops the background media upload queue and the sweep that deletes local originals; queued uploads stay queued.

routine_cloud_backup_writes_enabled.description: Kill switch. Off stops uploading user-authored routines and folders; they stay queued locally and flush when it returns.

routine_remote_deletes_enabled.description: Kill switch. Off stops deleting remote routine and folder documents; tombstones stay queued locally and replay when it returns.

routine_cloud_restore_enabled.description: Kill switch. Off stops decoding routine backups into local storage on sign-in and reinstall.

apple_health_enrichment_enabled.description: Kill switch. Off stops the background Apple Health pass that writes heart rate and calories onto recorded climbs; the retry ledger is left untouched, so pending climbs resume when it returns.

step_accuracy_raw_capture_upload_enabled.description: Kill switch. Off stops uploading raw headphone-motion captures of badly-miscounted climbs for debugging; the capture was never persisted, so a blocked climb's capture is simply not uploaded, not queued for later.

local_data_migrations_enabled.description: Kill switch. Off stops one-shot local backfills that rewrite stored workouts in bulk; they run on the next launch after it returns.

public_profile_publishing_enabled.description: Kill switch. Off stops publishing the public profile mirror, stats, and workout summaries.

champion_recognition_enabled.description: Kill switch. Off hides champion crowns, the champion strip, and past boards. Display only; nothing is written or deleted.

period_recap_enabled.description: Kill switch. Off stops presenting the period recap and writing its seenAt; unseen recaps wait on the server.

unlocks_enabled.description: Kill switch. Off hides every unlock surface: no carried items drawn, no unlock moment, no editor row. Display only; nothing is written or deleted, and earned items return with the switch.

firestore_memory_cache_enabled.description: Kill switch. Off lets a process launched with 200 MiB+ free run Firestore on a 20 MiB persistent cache instead of the memory cache; server reads, sync and the heartbeat still stop at the low-disk floor, but other reads can abort a full phone. Cold launch.

attempt_heartbeats_enabled.description: Kill switch. Off stops writing the sixty-second liveness heartbeat (users/{uid}/attempt_heartbeats) during a headphone session; nothing is queued, the climb itself is untouched, and the server's stall detector simply sees no heartbeat for that session.

headphone_session_auto_resume_enabled.description: Kill switch. Off stops resuming a dead headphone session automatically on relaunch (the wall-clock gap credit and the sensor restart); every recovered draft goes through the recovery screen instead, untouched until the climber acts.
